recognize_zh: 骨髓切片被片狀的非典型漿細胞取代（細胞質豐富、核偏位、核仁明顯），多顆細胞核內可見圓形淡嗜酸性、周圍有空暈的包涵體（Dutcher bodies），部分形成環狀外觀。
features: Sheets of large atypical plasma cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and eccentric round nuclei, replacing normal marrow elements
Nuclear pleomorphism with vesicular chromatin and conspicuous nucleoli (anaplastic/plasmablastic features)
Multiple round, pale eosinophilic intranuclear inclusions surrounded by a clear halo (Dutcher bodies), some creating a ring-like nucleus
Occasional extracellular or intracytoplasmic eosinophilic globular material and scattered mitotic figures
Residual fat spaces; normal hematopoiesis largely absent in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows near-complete replacement by sheets of large atypical plasma cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei, vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli. Numerous plasma cells contain round, pale eosinophilic intranuclear inclusions with a surrounding clear halo, representing Dutcher bodies (cytoplasmic immunoglobulin invaginating into the nucleus). Mitotic figures are present and normal hematopoietic elements are scant. Findings are consistent with extensive involvement by plasma cell myeloma with anaplastic features and abundant Dutcher bodies.

ddx.vs: Dutcher bodies are also common, but the infiltrate is a mixture of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and mature plasma cells with MYD88 L265P rather than sheets of large anaplastic plasma cells.
Morphology and CD138+/CD20- phenotype overlap; favor myeloma when there is a serum/urine M-protein, CRAB features and no EBV (EBER) or HIV/immunodeficiency context.
Epithelial cells form cohesive clusters and are cytokeratin positive, lacking CD138/MUM1 with light chain restriction.
Immunoblasts express CD20/PAX5, whereas myeloma cells are CD20/PAX5 negative with monotypic cytoplasmic light chain.
